description: CMXM Cookie Consent — POPIA-first consent and tracking management for WordPress. By Steno.
changelog:
1.2.15 — Separate Privacy and Cookie Policy links

  • Add an optional Cookie Policy URL under General settings, with automatic fallback to the existing Privacy Policy URL.
  • Show separate links for separate policies, a combined link when URLs are the same, and no broken links when URLs are empty.
  • Apply policy links consistently to the banner and cookie preferences, with developer guidance in General.
  • Include dedicated Cookie Policy text in the POPIA readiness audit when configured.
  • Preserve existing consent settings, GA4/GTM Consent Mode options, cookie inventory, consent logs and automatic updates.
